instagram.caption:
Paid for something that never arrived? You have a legal right to dispute it 💳

Under the Fair Credit Billing Act, you can dispute billing errors on a credit card, including goods you paid for but did not receive, generally within 60 days of the statement that first showed the charge. Write to the issuer's billing-error address; while it investigates, you generally don't have to pay the disputed amount. Keep your records. Not legal advice.

Follow for more rights most people never use.

General info, not legal advice. Laws vary by state.
